q: 1. The concealed faces of the frames of doors and windows are painted with
options: two coats of same enamel paint which is applied for the rest of the frame
explain: The hidden surfaces of the frame (touching the wall) are usually painted with primer or wood preservative to prevent rot.

q: 2. Minimum side lap required for asbestos cement sheets is
explain: For AC corrugated sheets, a minimum side lap of half a corrugation (approx 4-5 cm) is required for weatherproofing.

q: 3. The concealed faces of the frames of doors and windows are painted with
options: two coats of enamel paint which is applied for the rest of the frame
explain: The faces of the wood frame that come into contact with the masonry are painted with coal tar to protect the wood from moisture and termite attack.

q: 4. Size, capacity and materials need be specified for
explain: Plumbing fixtures and valves must be defined by their dimensions, flow capacity, and material (e.g., brass, CP, PVC) for accurate pricing in an estimate.

q: 5. The thickness of 25 gauge sheet is
explain: A 25 gauge (Standard Wire Gauge) sheet is approximately 0.508 mm thick, which is clearly less than 1 mm.

q: 6. The document in which the quality of the work or material is mentioned is called:
explain: Specifications are detailed descriptions that define the quality of materials, workmanship, and methods required for the project.

q: 7. Specification of works is required only when the work is carried out by:
explain: While quality is always important, formal contract specifications are primarily the legal basis for holding a 'contractor' accountable for work quality.

q: 8. The information which cannot be included in drawings is conveyed to the estimator through
explain: Specifications cover descriptions of material quality, workmanship, and execution methods that visual drawings cannot adequately show.

q: 9. While doing filling work in trenches, the thickness of each layer should not be
explain: To ensure proper compaction and prevent future settlement, soil filling should be done in layers not exceeding 20 cm in thickness.

q: 10. For rolling shutters, the minimum depth of guide channels for and upto 3.5 m wide shutter shall be
explain: To provide adequate lateral support and prevent the shutter from blowing out, a minimum guide channel depth of 60 mm is required for shutters up to 3.5 m.

q: 11. The two important types of specification commonly used are
explain: Specifications generally focus on the quality of Materials and the method of execution for each Item of work.

q: 12. The thickness of 25 gauge sheet is
explain: Standard Gauge 25 (SWG) for metal sheets corresponds to approximately 0.5 mm, which is less than 1 mm.
